title: SCS Version Manifest
description: The record `scs bundle version` writes beside a versioned bundle, named <bundle-name>-v<version>-MANIFEST.yaml (RFC 0002 sections 9 and 11, spec bundle-format.md section 7.6). content_digest and tools_version are optional here so manifests written before 0.7 still validate; a manifest whose version has a workspace-qualified tag must carry both, which is checked against the tags, not by this schema (D-49).

tools_version.description: Version of scs-tools that wrote the manifest

content_digest.description: Digest of the bundle's full resolved content (bundle-format.md section 7.6)

content_inputs.description: Digest of every bundle manifest and SCD in the tree, used only to name what changed on a mismatch

person.description: A person identifier, Name <email> (D-28). Role-only attribution (role:<name>) is allowed in intake.yaml only, never for an approver.
